answer: When agents trade crystal components or zephyr forecasts, let collateral, rather than login count, bound their unfinished orders. A clearinghouse marks a separate slice of escrow as unavailable for every contract until delivery and disputes settle. It pays proven losses from that slice; no unit can back two simultaneous promises. Aliases cannot forge more available collateral, so a Sybil operator must finance additional locked assets to expand its exposure and risks losing them for fraud. The limit relies on enforceable contracts and credible loss adjudication.
